models_evaluated: PEACH (LLM chatbot with 35 embedded peri-operative protocols)

links.outcome: Accuracy of chatbot responses in silent deployment on real-world data versus guidelines and expert consensus
links.effect: Overall accuracy 96.7% (232/240) across three iterations; updated PEACH 97.9% (235/240), significantly above 95% null (p = 0.018).
links.quote: The system was tested with a silent deployment using real-world data.

links.outcome: Hallucinations and deviations when LLM is grounded in embedded institutional protocols
links.quote: Hallucinations and deviations were minimal (1/240 and 2/240, respectively).

unlisted_practices: Embedding institutional protocols into a secure LLM environment with iterative prompt engineering

screen.reason: The study evaluates the real-world deployment and safety of an LLM chatbot using a silent deployment phase, assessing safety, hallucinations, and protocol amendments.
